neighbours.label: ' and' joining two coordinated actions or items in a sequence (warm it in the oven and then throw it in a pan; jump and slash)
fire: First you rinse the rice in cold water and then you let it soak for an hour.
The cat crouched behind the sofa and pounced on the toy mouse.
To finish the move, press the block button and kick at the same time.
She mixed vodka and tomato juice, which her guests politely refused.
He sanded the old table by hand and painted it a pale green.
Heat the butter in the pan and quickly add the sliced mushrooms.
The players learn to dodge and counter in the first training session.
We packed the tent in the car and drove north before sunrise.
quiet: First you rinse the rice in cold water so that the starch washes away.
The cat crouched behind the sofa, watching the toy mouse closely.
To finish the move, press the block button at exactly the right time.
She mixed a cocktail with tomato juice, which her guests politely refused.
He sanded the old table by hand over a whole weekend in June.
Heat the butter in the pan until it starts to turn golden brown.
The players learn to dodge attacks in the first training session.
We packed the tent in the car the night before our long drive.

notes: ' and' is x17 of the top 32; the strongest join two verb phrases ('warm it ... and then quickly throw', 'jump and slash', 'gin and grapefruit'). Near misses keep the scene with one action and no coordinating 'and'.
